children: Overview
France biotechnology firm's H1 2026 net loss widened as operating expenses increased
Company completed royalty certificate buy-back, reducing royalty overhang and strengthening debt-free position
Abivax raised €767.1 mln in July public offering, extending cash runway into Q4 2029
Outlook
Abivax projects cash runway into Q4 2029 based on current operating assumptions
Company plans NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis by end of 2026
Abivax expects topline results from Phase 2b Crohn’s disease trial in mid-2027
Result Drivers
R&D EXPANSION - Higher R&D expenses driven by expanded clinical programs and preparations for potential commercialization of obefazimod
INFRASTRUCTURE INVESTMENT - G&A expenses rose due to personnel costs, share-based compensation, and consulting fees for building commercial infrastructure
COMMERCIAL PREPARATION - Sales and marketing expenses increased as company prepared for potential future sales and commercialization of obefazimod in the U.S.
